notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Hornet Queen.
description:
Activate Hornet Queen by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator triggers.
Resolve the Hornet Queen trigger, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Hornet Queen.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Insects, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
